title: Quacky's Better Totem
description: A little mod that makes totem more customisable with small optimisations and just pure aesthetic fun :)
body:
# Quacky's Better Totems

Customize every part of Totem of Undying pop. Client-side only. Works on Lunar, Modrinth App, Feather, vanilla Fabric.

## Features

- **Custom sounds** — import any `.ogg`, set volume + pitch per profile.
- **Custom particle colors** — separate palettes for self, teammates, others.
- **HUD pop tweaks** — scale, spin speed, particle density.
- **Profiles** — make as many as you want. Name them, duplicate, cycle through.
- **Live preview** — "Test Totem Pop" button plays the full activation without consuming an item.
- **ModMenu config** — everything lives in a clean in-game GUI.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) ≥ 0.19.2 for MC 1.21.11.
2. Drop into `mods/`:
   - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer
   - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) 17.0.0 or newer
   - `quackys-better-totems-1.0.0.jar`

Client-only — no server-side install needed.

## Usage

- Open Mod Menu → **Quacky's Better Totems** → configure.
- Dashboard: toggle mod, switch active profile, test pop.
- Profiles: rename inline, duplicate, delete.
- Editor: import PNG/OGG, set colors + scale + animation per profile.
- Save & Close to persist.

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11 only (Yarn API drift means cross-version isn't a single jar).
- **Loaders:** Fabric. Other launchers (Lunar, Modrinth, Feather) work as long as they ship 1.21.11.
- **Conflicts:** none known. File picker uses LWJGL TinyFileDialogs — no AWT, no Lunar OpenGL clash.

## Known limitations

- HUD totem texture override not yet implemented (1.21.11 item-model rewrite is invasive). Custom texture import is wired up for future use.
- HUD color tint relies on a removed `RenderSystem.setShaderColor` API; color shows up in particles only for now.

## License

MIT. Quack responsibly.

## Other Mods
Make sure to check out my organisation to find other mods! Helps a lot and lets me make more mods and maybe a common library in the future :)
